# Narration attribution

Eye Rest's original English guidance was generated locally with Kokoro-82M v1.0 by hexgrad, voice af_heart, fixed model revision f3ff3571791e39611d31c381e3a41a3af07b4987. Model and voice assets are Apache-2.0; the license is included alongside this notice. Source: https://huggingface.co/hexgrad/Kokoro-82M and https://github.com/hexgrad/kokoro.

Only generated PCM narration is distributed in the app. The source model, runtime and any personal podcast recordings are not included. No voice cloning was used. Prompt text, full decode result, durations and SHA256 hashes are recorded in narration-provenance.json.
